readme.run: Score a lesion against every bundle of the ENIGMA Symmetric atlas
notes: Add --atlas hcp1065 for the HCP1065 population-averaged atlas.
The lesion must be on the MNI152 1 mm grid (182 x 218 x 182); normalize
it with SYNcro first. Both TVX atlases are included and checked locally.
No network connection or previously populated cache is required.
Add --help for options. Input is NIfTI only; the web app converts DICOM.
